name: trend-machine
base: api/v1/ relative to the site root. Works on any static host; no auth, no keys, no rate limits.

trends.description: All topics, full editorial dossiers: angles, hooks, sources[], first_seen/last_seen, stale + seeded flags. The canonical record — sort by opportunity_score desc for the hottest plays.
trends.notes: Seeded topics (seeded:true) carry researched starting-point figures in their summaries — treat as baselines, not live measurements.

trends_flat.description: Flat consumer feed: opportunity-ranked, stale topics excluded. Lightweight 'what to make content about today' list. Every item carries 'velocity_trend': snapshots/delta/since plus a ready-made inline SVG sparkline (wave 8) — honest 'building' state when fewer than 3 snapshots exist.

trends_flat_sample.description: Clearly-labeled SAMPLE (sample:true) derived from seeded topics — for consumer development only, never the live path.

trends_flat_js.description: JSONP twin of the flat feed — trendsCallback({...}). The CORS-safe fallback for pure static hosts that cannot send Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers.

velocity.description: Oracle input: hourly velocity/opportunity snapshots per topic, ascending by timestamp. Classify with assets/js/trajectory.js (UMD — loadable in node) or read the precomputed api/v1/forecasts.json.
velocity.notes: Snapshots are real pipeline observations; topics with <3 snapshots get no forecast.

platform_velocity.description: Wave 6: per-platform hourly velocity series per topic ({topic_id: {platform: [[iso, vel], ...]}}). Starting points — series build one snapshot per refresh; trajectories classify after 3+ per-platform snapshots.
platform_velocity.notes: Empty/missing series mean 'still building history', never a guess.

meme_formats.description: Wave 9: the tracked meme format families — hand-curated from Oct-2026 web research (verified = 2+ independent sources; single-source = one source or creator lore, flagged). Each family carries current examples with evidence URLs and the live topic ids whose text matches the family this run (tracked_topics — derived, never stale).
meme_formats.notes: Topics link back via their format_family field (null when unmatched).

seed_freshness.description: Wave 14: the seed-freshness sweep — every seeded topic checked for staleness: source URL liveness (HTTP probe; dead = GET 404/410 only — HEAD rejections fall through to GET, timeouts never mark stale), store corroboration (last_seen <= 7d), and velocity tracking (a seed with <3 snapshots but a first snapshot <6h old is warming up, not stale). Verdicts: healthy / stale-source / stale-untracked / flaky-warning.
seed_freshness.notes: Generated by scripts/seed_freshness.py (not in refresh.sh — run as a periodic audit).

forecasts.description: Oracle output: precomputed trajectory classifications (peaking_48h / rising_fast / cooling_off / steady) from the same classifier as the dashboard. Every forecast is a projection from N snapshots — never a guarantee. Wave 6 adds confidence basis, signal attribution, and per-platform trajectories.
forecasts.notes: Topics with fewer than 3 snapshots are excluded from the lists (counts.insufficient). Additive-only changes; no payload-shape breaks.

forecast_accuracy.description: The Oracle's own scorecard: forecast-vs-actual ledger (hit/miss per forecast after a 48h horizon). Hit rate shown only after 10+ forecasts resolve; before that the status is 'building history'.
forecast_accuracy.notes: Started 2026-10-11 — first resolutions land 48h later. Nothing backfilled.

changelog: 0.6.0 (2026-10-11/12): Wave 13 — the two missing wave-9 seeds land: turn-to-your-neighbor and zayn-sleeping-photo, verified live against Know Your Meme (both entries updated within the day) and meme.com's meme library. Wave 14 — ledger health: forecast resolution gains a terminal 'unverifiable' verdict (48h passed, <2 actual snapshots — counted separately, never in the hit rate) with full evidence recorded (window bounds, point counts, thresholds); the resolution rules live in one shared module (scripts/resolution-lib.js) used by both the hourly pipeline and the standalone scripts/check_resolutions.js audit. New api/v1/seed-freshness.json endpoint: the seed-freshness audit (scripts/seed_freshness.py) verdicts every seed healthy / stale-source / stale-untracked / flaky-warning with per-source probe results. Additive only. 0.5.0 (2026-10-11): Wave 9 — Oracle accuracy scorecard becomes a full page (forecast-accuracy.html): honest pre-resolution states, per-horizon accuracy table, by-call breakdown, recent resolutions, current 48h projections, and the resolution method — all rendered live from api/v1/forecast-accuracy.json, with the hit rate shown only after 10+ forecasts resolve. New meme-format family tracking: data/meme_formats.json curates 12 hand-researched Oct-2026 format families (verified/single-source flags kept honest), pipeline/format_families.py matches topics to families by conservative keyword rules (re-computed every run), every topic carries format_family, dossiers show a family chip linking to formats.html, and api/v1/meme-formats.json publishes the families with their live topic links. Additive only, no shape changes. 0.4.0 (2026-10-11): Wave 8 — velocity sparkline history UI + 'Remix this' exporter polish. Every flat-feed item now carries 'velocity_trend': snapshot count, first/latest velocity, delta, tracked-since label, a pre-rendered inline SVG sparkline, and per-platform mini-summaries — all from real snapshot data; topics with <3 snapshots report state 'building' with no fake line. Dossier pages gained per-platform mini-sparklines and a <details> snapshot data-table for screen readers; the dashboard table gained a sparkline column. The remix exporter is now a pure unit-tested function (pinned fixtures) and copies best platforms too. Additive only, no shape changes. 0.3.0 (2026-10-11): Wave 7 — Oct-2026 trend-drop refresh: 12 new topics (SocialPilot Sept 25–Oct 10 re-check: Did I Win This Trend?, 31 Days of Halloween, Halloween Home Tour, Creepy Fact Storytime, DIP ON EM, #CityTasteTest, Homecoming Proposal Reveal, girl in red 'we fell in love in october', Memo Boy 'Insomniac', Spooky Scary Skeletons remix, Patient Zero TikTok Search Hub, pumpkin patch season); new 'trend_type' field on every topic (format/topic/format+topic, rule-derived from format_tags + category); seeded topics carry a 'verification' flag (verified/single-source/unverified — unverified topics render name-only sources with a confirm-live note). Bow Bow Bow re-graded to Peak/saturation-high. Additive only, no shape changes. 0.2.1 (2026-10-11): Oracle 2.0 — forecasts.json records now carry confidence basis (snapshot count + fit quality), signal attribution (velocity delta, slope, accel, recency, cross-platform spread, fired thresholds), and per-platform trajectories (additive only, no shape changes). New api/v1/platform-velocity.json and api/v1/forecast-accuracy.json (the Oracle's own forecast-vs-actual log; 'building history' until 10+ forecasts resolve). 0.2.0 (2026-10-11): index.json endpoints are now objects {path, description, schema, updated, records, notes} (was plain path strings). Added flat-feed, JSONP, velocity entries; draft-07 schemas for every endpoint under api/v1/schema/. api/v1/forecasts.json is added by the post-build forecast step (scripts/build_forecasts.js) when present.
usage: GET api/v1/trends.json, sort by opportunity_score desc for the hottest plays. Start at api/v1/index.json for the full endpoint map.
